protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The Pi summary line states 325 successes / 169 failures / 4 errors while its embedded result.json reports six errors. W1 retains the 65.0% score and does not fabricate a corrected breakdown.
The OpenCode summary states 274 successes / 225 failures / 4 errors, which does not sum to the stated 500-task population. W1 retains the 54.8% score.
The OpenClaw benchmark file has an H1 ending in OpenCode while the filename and explicit Harness field identify OpenClaw. W1 uses the explicit Harness field and records the heading mismatch.
The run sheets identify the 500-task SWE-bench Verified surface but do not bind an immutable upstream dataset commit/ref.
